title: 4-Pack Collapsible Silicone Kitchen Funnel Set | Small & Large Sizes for Bottles, Liquid Transfer, Cooking | Dishwasher Safe & Space-Saving Design
description:
About this item
Multi-Size Versatility - Includes 2 small and 2 large funnels (sizes vary) to handle tasks from filling spice jars to large water bottles, oil transfers, or DIY projects.
Foldable & Compact - Made of flexible silicone, these funnels collapse flat for easy storage in drawers or travel kits. Perfect for RVs, camping, or small kitchens.
Food-Grade Safety - Qgond funnels use 100% BPA-free silicone, heat-resistant (-40°F to 446°F), and safe for contact with oils, sauces, or beverages.
Effortless Cleaning - Smooth non-stick surface prevents residue. Rinse instantly or toss in the dishwasher for hassle-free maintenance.
Leak-Proof Design - Flexible silicone creates a tight seal on bottle mouths to avoid spills during pouring.
reviews_5s: These silicone funnels work great for everything from filling water bottles to transferring dry goods into jars. I like that they come in different sizes, which makes them useful for a variety of container openings. They collapse flat, so storing them in a kitchen drawer is no problem at all. The silicone feels sturdy but flexible enough to create a good seal and prevent spills. Cleanup is simple—just rinse or toss them in the dishwasher. I’ve used them with both liquids and dry ingredients, and they’ve held up well without staining or sticking. Overall, they’re a practical addition to my kitchen tools.
